# PR #3 parser snapshots

Reference: `c0aa1d20e1c2225f8c792996c4d5215477d04881` (`codex/ox-native-islands-production`). These files are test data and are never imported by the SSG runtime.

- `corpus-pr3.json`: 1,440 Markdown sources, SHA-256 of normalized text/structure and href/src/alt/id/style/title, metadata (title/description/path/TOC), and component props. Whitespace and hoisted styles are checked by VRT. Props on the intentionally empty MkSchemaViewer are excluded.
- `inline-pr3.json`: all 201 distinct multiline Markdown strings in the existing YAML guides/history, with normalized tree hashes.
- `markdown-pr3.json`: full ASTs for small legacy-authoring contracts, including attributes, raw HTML, nested components, spans, links and task lists.

The expected output was collected from an independent checkout of #3 using its original `ssg/mdc.mjs` parser. It was not generated by the new Ox parser. For the mechanical syntax corrections in this migration, `originalSourceSha256` records the old source while `sourceSha256` identifies the migrated source; the expected output remains the old parser's output.

These are historical migration snapshots. A later editorial change or deleted file is reported as changed and skipped instead of freezing the content to historical text. New documents are covered by the native syntax tests and VRT. Updating an expected migration output requires an intentional review; do not regenerate these expected hashes from the implementation under test.
